tei:div.tei:p: 615) ༄༅/ grub dbang pad+ma nor bu'i bka' 'bum ca rtag can la/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor ye shes mchog ster ldeb/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor ye shes mchog sbyin la ldeb/ zab lam bla sgrub brgyud 'debs ldeb/ zab lam bla ma'i sgrub pa dngos grub rgya mtsho'i sprin phung ldeb rtsa gsum bla ma'i rnal 'byor grub gnyis 'dod 'jo la ldeb/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor byin rlabs char 'bebs ldeb/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor rtsa brgyud sogs ldeb/ grub dbang dpal chen 'dus pa'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor ldeb/ bka' drin che phra du mas skyong ba'i rang gi bla ma rnams kyis mtshan byang la ldeb/ bla rnal thig le nyag gcig ldeb/ nyid kyi mtshan gyi rnam grangs las brtsams zhabs brtan smon tshig ldeb/ bla ma mchod pa'i cho ga byin rlabs bdud rtsi'i char rgyun ldeb/ bla ma'i gsol 'debs yid kyi gdung sel ldeb/ gsol 'debs rig 'dzin chen po so sogs ldeb/ gsol 'debs 'jam dpal rjes bzung sogs ldeb/ 616) bla ma rgyang 'bod mos gus dad pa'i gsos sbyin ldeb/ 'dod don gsol 'debs ldeb/ bla brgyud gsol 'debs ldeb/ thugs dam bskang ba rnam gsum la ldeb/ gu ru'i gsol 'debs ldeb/ rig 'dus rgyun khyer ldeb/ nyams 'gur dus nam yang sogs ldeb/ ang yig sum bcu'i snying gtam ldeb/ mgur 'bum e ma sogs ldeb/ nyams mgur sku gsum rang chas ldeb/ rdzogs chen bla brgyud gsol 'debs ldeb/ mgur 'bum skyabs bka' drin zla bral ldeb/ skyo glu rang gnas gnyug ma'i sogs ldeb/ skyo glu kyai ma kye hud sogs dang zhal gdams gsan dang bcas la ldeb/ zhal gdams rnam med bde ba'i sogs ldeb/ zhal gdams dpal dus gsum sogs ldeb/ zhal gdams gsan dang sogs ldeb/ bca' yig mi chog brgyad bcu la ldeb/ bsngo smon ldeb/ ye thig skor ldeb/ sgom rim gsol ba'i me long ldeb/ rgyud lugs 'jam dpal zhi ba'i bsnyen pa gtong ba'i lag len zin thun mdor bsdus ldeb/

bla ma dgongs pa 'dus 617) pa las/ mkha' 'gro sde lnga'i rten 'brel mo yig snying por dril ba/ kar gling zhi khro chags med lugs ltar 'don pa'i zin chung ldeb/ sil snyan rdung tshul ldeb/ rtsa gsum spyi yi me mchod las bzhi'i bang mdzod ldeb/ yum chen mo'i dbang bskur mdor bsdus ldeb/ rdor sems thugs kyi sgrub pa'i rus sbyong bya tshul rig 'dzin brgyud pa'i phyag bzhes ldeb/ bla ma gsang ba 'dus pa'i rgyun gyi phrin las 'jug bder bkod pa ldeb/ bla ma dgongs pa 'dus pa'i lo rgyus shel gyi me long snying po'i bcud phyung ldeb/ dgongs 'dus cho ga'i 'don 'grigs ldeb/ klong chen snying gi thig le'i cha lag sa nad bra ba'i gnod pa zhi ba'i las rim phan bde'i dpal ster zhes bya ba ldeb/ bka' brgyad gsang ba yongs rdzogs kyi skong chog dang gnas 'dren mtshams sbyor bcas phyogs gcig tu bris pa la ldeb/ sgrub pa bka' brgyad khro bo rol pa 'don bder bsdebs pa la ldeb/ kha skong ldeb/ brgyud pa'i kha skong rnam smin sogs ldeb/ 618) tsha ru sprul sku la gdams pa ldeb/ gyang khang sprul sku la gdams pa'i ka rtsom ldeb/ gnam chos sngags ka tim na'i 'brel pa ldeb/ zhabs brtan thub bstan sman ljongs sogs ldeb/ smrar shod rgya ra dgon nas gsungs pa'i zhabs brtan ldeb/ bsam lhun bsdus pa ldeb/ smon tshig kun mkhyen sogs ldeb/ thub bstan phyogs kyi glang po'i zhabs brtan ldeb/ nyi ma mkha' khyab 'gro don dang*/ chu bo dbyings khyab 'gro don bcas la ldeb/ sems bskyed skor ldeb/ gtad bzlog bya thabs ldeb/ dung chen 'bud tshig ngang pa mtsho 'khor ldeb/ mkha' 'gro bdud 'dul seng gdong drag mo las/ rgyun gyi rnal 'byor dngos grub char 'bebs ldeb/ bzlog bcol ldeb/ che mchog dpal dgu'i bzlog bcol ldeb/ rnam dag bde ba can du skye ba'i thabs la 'bad pa'i tshul drang srong ston mo zhes bya ba ldeb/

nyer mkho ldeb/ rtsa gsum gsol bsdus ldeb/ dpal ldan ma mgon lcam dral bstod pa rnal 'byor gdung ba'i nga ro ldeb/ ma mgon gtor ma'i 619) spra nag skor ldeb/ rdo rje ngang dkar gsol mchod ldeb/ bka' brgyad srung ma'i gsol bsdus skor ldeb/ rtsa gsum srung ma spyi'i gsol bsdus mi pham zhal lung ldeb/ bka' srung gsol bsdus phrin las myur mgyogs ldeb/ bsang*/ kyai/ bskal bzang rnam 'dren sogs ldeb/ smra shod go 'jo'i bsang gsol ldeb/ rdzogs pa chen po sangs rgyas lag 'chang gi sngon 'gro'i ngag 'don dang dmigs rim sbrel tshul bla ma'i zhal lung ldeb/ sngon 'gro bsags sbyong byed tshul mdor bsdus snying par dril ba ldeb/ sngon 'gro'i khrid rim zhig la ldeb/ sngon 'gro'i ngag 'don byang chub myur lam ldeb/ gnam chos thugs gter la brten pa'i bla ma mchod pa'i cho ga me tog phreng ba zhes bya ba ldeb/ gnam chos thugs kyi gter kha snyan brgyud zab mo'i skor gyi zhi khro bsam gtan cho ga 'brel tshad rang grol ldeb/ gnam chos 'od chog 'don zin ldeb/ thog mar dkar chag rang nyid la ldeb/ bcas bsdoms ldeb 620)grangs/ ༈ rgyal kun spyi gzugs mtsho skyes rje'i/ ring lugasa'adzin la zla bral ba// thub bstan chos kyi glang po yi// phrin las sa gsum khyab gyur cig dge'o//
